bends.note: gentle curve: Reading runs SSW (dx/dy ~-0.16) from the top edge to here and slightly more westerly (dx/dy ~-0.23) to the next angle point
angle point: Reading turns back to SSW (dx/dy ~-0.25) and runs straight to Elsinore

notes: Deer Creek valley between Reading Road (west) and Gilbert Avenue (east), Elsinore along the bottom; mostly lots, the C.L.& N. R.R., the City Water Works pipe yard and Eden Park. The bottom street is printed 'ELSINORE (AV.) PL.' (with '600 ELSINORE AV.' and '630 ELSINORE AV.' on pastes), 100 ft; named Elsinore Avenue to match sheets 159/160. Reading ('READING R'D', 70') meets Elsinore from the north-east side only at the bottom-left corner (sheet 159 has the same T). Deer Creek Road is printed 'DEER CREEK R'D (NOT OPEN)', 60 ft, running straight SSW (dx/dy ~-0.145) from the top edge (continues from sheet 167) to Elsinore; its last ~550 px north of Elsinore are dashed on a correction paste labelled 'CITY PARK' and '(STREET VACATED)' (the same paste wording as sheet 167). South of Elsinore there is a ~60 ft gap in the block line (block corners ~(1410,4426) and ~(1632,4369)) exactly on the line of Deer Creek Road, which continues onto sheet 160 (its dashed 'DEER CREEK R'D (NOT OPENED)'), so this is listed as a cross. Gilbert ('GILBERT AV.', 100', 8 in. pipe) is straight (dx/dy ~-0.13); centre taken midway between its block lines (the pipe runs ~30 px west of centre). Gilbert/Elsinore is a T: east of Gilbert there is no 100 ft street, only a narrow (~23 ft) opening labelled 'ELSINORE GATE' between Gilbert's east-line corners ~(2947,3780) and ~(2937,3858), leading into a dashed park drive ('ROAD') curving south through Eden Park; it is a park entrance, not a street, so no point is given. The gap in the block line south of Elsinore at x~1900-2064 carries the C.L.& N. R.R. tracks, not a street. The dash-dot line A-B near the top marked '167' is the sheet-167 join line.
